root: ^The Sister stands with her hands tucked into her sleeves, her calm presence at odds with the frantic energy of the ballroom.

g-0: ^"Blessings, child. Even in revelry, we must remember our souls."

s: ^"What do you think of the royal family?"

mission_talk: ^"Even the faithful must engage with the world." She sighs softly. "Though I confess, the sin of pride is thick here tonight."

g-0: ^"I saw Flora weeping in the chapel garden earlier. She spoke of ruin and revenge."
g-1: ^"When I offered counsel, she asked, 'Sister, is murder a sin if it prevents a greater evil?'"
g-2: ^The Sister looks down at her prayer beads. "I... I didn't know how to answer."

unusual_talk: ^"The Lord sees all, and sometimes, so do I." She lowers her voice significantly.

g-0: ^"That servant, Estelle, confessed to me last week. She said she was being forced to carry messages—terrible messages—and feared for her life."
g-1: ^"I told her to trust in God's protection, but..."
g-2: ^She shakes her head. "I saw her earlier, clutching a letter addressed to Brooklyn. The poor child looked hunted."

royal_talk: ^"It's not my place to judge earthly crowns, but..." She chooses her words carefully.

g-0: ^"Brooklyn has the mind of a ruler even though Gaten is next in line."
g-1: ^"One wonders what God intends for this kingdom when the worthy lack power and the powerful lack worth."
g-2: ^"Cornellius once told me that kingdoms fall when the wrong person holds the scepter."
g-3: ^"I fear Alistair and he may be engineering that very fall."

ending: ^She makes a small sign of blessing in the air.
